notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
1.2 Patch Notes:

Fixed bug where default mouse sensitivity was 0 causing players to not be able to move their mouse until they changed it in their settings

notes.title: Patch 1.1 | QoL Changes
notes.content:
1.1 Patch Notes:

 Added functionality to enable Speedrun Timer
 Added Mouse Sensitivity setting
 Added Master Volume setting
 Changed the map to show the player location as well as X, also adjusted animation for better visibility
 Added objectives on screen so the player can focus on gameplay rather than being confused about what must be done
 Added 3 new difficulties: Casual, Normal and Impossible
 Improved item visibility
 Adjusted door opening and closing sounds to have some variance and be less of an ear pain
 Removed vent crawling animation
 Fixed bug with door losing collision

notes.title: Patch 1.0 | Bug Fixes
notes.content:
1.0 Patch Notes:

 Fixed the player flashlight illumination
 Fix flashlight illumination in the vents
 Fixed a bug where player would fall out of the map if they tried jumping in the lockers
 Added more clarity to where the player needs to go once they collect all 10 notes and items


If you guys encounter any bugs please do reach out in the steam discussions or our discord!
